candidates.change_summary: Replace add_uint256 with sub_uint256 when crediting the deposit, so Put debits instead of credits the caller's balance (and can revert on underflow).
Delete the statement that credits msg.value to the caller's balance, so deposits are no longer recorded.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call, so Put no longer records a log entry.
Set acc.unlockTime unconditionally to _unlockTime, allowing unlock times in the past.

Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so it no longer toggles the reentrancy lock, changing observable revert behavior when Put is invoked while the lock is held (e.g., via the fallback during a reentrant call).
Delete the 'locked_ = false;' statement in the modifier so the lock is never released, causing every subsequent Put call to revert with the require failure.
Remove the balance subtraction after a successful payout, so Collect never deducts the withdrawn amount.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call in Collect so successful collections are not logged.
Replace `if (_s)` with `if (true)` so the balance is deducted and logged even when the external call fails.
Remove `locked_ = true;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrant Collect calls that can double-collect.
Remove `locked_ = false;` from the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released and any subsequent Put/Collect call reverts.
